prompt: Reskin image 1, the authored 3D plane material capture, into a finished hand-painted mossy stone game floor. Keep its full opaque square and flat overhead ground-plane projection. Refine the gray stone into tactile irregular surface chips, subtle cracks and soft moss in joints, with restrained painted detail and clean readable stone forms. Maintain screen-aligned square ground geometry and useful repeating stone layout. This is one seamless texture tile: patterns and color must continue across left/right and top/bottom edges without visible seams, border bands or sudden lighting/color-gradient jumps. Use evenly distributed diffuse lighting, with no directional global gradient. Fill the entire 256x256 reference square edge to edge; preserve its square aspect and complete canvas. No margins, transparency, raised front wall, border, props, cast shadow, text or grid overlay. Return only the complete opaque square floor texture.
